items.topic: Review app: reviewer test decisions pollute per-reviewer stores
items.claim: Testing the review app wrote fake decisions into real reviewer stores (review-state.<user>.json).
items.fact: Test logins write into openspec/changes/<change>/review-state.<user>.json. Clean up after tests: delete only test entries/files, then rebuild merged view via server.py m.write_merged(m.compute_merged()). Use a temp reviewer (review-state.zztest.json) for tests and remove it; the operator store (review-state.operator.json) must be preserved.

items.topic: Review app uses dashboard Keycloak SSO, no own login form
items.fact: Review page redirects to same Keycloak realm (pi-identity) and client (dashboard-web) as the dashboard, PKCE flow; silent sign-in if already signed in. Reviewer AIs still use /api/login with own credentials (review-decide.mjs). Browser cookies are per address: sign in once via http://192.168.10.219:8010/ not localhost.

items.topic: Reviewer conflicts not discoverable in review UI
items.claim: Operator: "⚠ 2 reviewer conflicts is what it says but i can't figure out how to see the conflict"
items.fact: The chip was only a tooltip. Added a 'Reviewer conflicts' filter option (value conflict), clickable sidebar chip that opens the first conflict, per-topic summary card listing conflicting items with each reviewer's vote and jump links, and team-votes block on each card. Content pane is its own scroll area (scroll via element ref in agent-browser).

items.topic: Anyone can settle a reviewer conflict by accepting one vote
items.claim: Operator: "add a way to overrite change anyone can do that! see conflict and resolve by accepting one"
items.fact: Any signed-in person can click 'Settle as <vote>' on a conflicting item. Settlements stored in review-resolutions.json (items+history; not matched by review-state.*.json glob), each reviewer's vote kept; conflict reopens automatically if a reviewer changes vote after settlement (timestamp newer than settlement). Server: server.py RESOLVE, write_resolutions.
Undo settlement button and server action removed; settling is final from the UI. Only reopens when a reviewer changes their own vote.

items.topic: Hide all trace of conflict after settlement
items.claim: Operator: "✓ Settled as accept by boti ... remove this don't show!!!" then "shoudl all trace of conflict after resolution should be removed"
items.fact: After settlement the UI shows no 'Settled as' banner, no Team votes list, no conflict chips/filter hit. teamBlock() returns '' when v.resolved && !v.conflict. Side effect: reviewer notes in that block are also hidden (offered to keep notes).

items.topic: Reviewer AI sessions lack tools to approve/reject with text
items.claim: Operator: "You have not added for the session to use tools to approve or reject or make any decision with text using the tool calls"
items.fact: Reviewer AI sessions need tool-call access to record decisions. Existing mechanism: target/review-docker/skill/blueprint-review/{SKILL.md,review-decide.mjs} (copied to work/<user>/.pi/skills/blueprint-review/), CLI: `review-decide.mjs list [--undecided]` and `set <id> <accept|needs-change|defer|reject> [note]` posting /api/item with token from /api/login. Agent needs a native tool (not bash instructions) wired in pi plugins (target/review-docker/plugins) so text decisions work via tool calls; was being investigated.

items.topic: agent-browser typing races and Keycloak login
items.claim: fill of password in agent-browser sometimes lands truncated, sign-in fails although API login works.
items.fact: Verify credentials via API password grant to token endpoint (/realms/pi-identity/protocol/openid-connect/token, client dashboard-web); if browser fails, retype with `type` / re-snapshot refs and click Sign In again. Browser tool restart loses Keycloak session; 'A daemon for session default started concurrently' error: just retry the command. Refs change after every snapshot/navigation.

items.topic: kb guard warns on repeated source search
items.claim: Repeated grep/sed of source triggers '[kb] Repeated source searching, still no kb consult'.
items.fact: Run kb_search / kb agents / kb get first; if kb has no answer carry on. kb_search found blueprint-review SKILL at target/review-docker/skill/blueprint-review/SKILL.md (index may be stale while refresh runs).

items.topic: Review app URL hash deep-link does not select topic
items.claim: Opening http://...:8791/?v=conf3#<topic id> falls back to first topic.
items.fact: Hash deep link with URL-encoded id did not match a topic; navigate via sidebar link instead (or fix hash handling).
